songs.title: HABAYE UMUNSI
paragraphs:
I. Habaye umunsi w’ishimwe mu ijuru,
Yesu yitanga ngo agere mu isi;
Aza kubyarwa n’umwari utunganye,
Uwera aturana natwe ababi.

Dore urukundo rwatumye ampfira
Ibyaha byanjye abihamba mu mva !
Maze arazuka ngo ampuze na se.
Nagaruka, nzamushimira ibyo.

II. Habaye umunsi babamba umukiza
I Gologota ku musaraba.
Ahemurwa avumwa atukwa n’abantu,
Yikorera ibyaha byanjye byose!

III. Habaye umunsi aruhukira mu mva
Harindwa n’abamarayika be.
Niko yitanze ngo ambere umukiza;
Bihebe mwese, mumwiringire!

IV. Habaye umunsi, Satani aratsindwa,
Ntiyaheza Yesu mu gituro.
Nuko arazuka, urupfu arutsinze,
None ari mu ijuru iburyo bwa Se

V. Hazaba umunsi tuzumvaho impanda
Harabagirane ijuru ryose;
Yesu uwo azaza mu bwiza bwe bwose
Azima ingoma uwo Mwami wanjye.

songs.title: IKI GIHE TURIMO
paragraphs:
Iki gihe turimo ni icy’ibibazo, ku baremwe bose
Umuntu wese yibaza ku by’iki gihe, ntabone igisubizo /2

Gore: Muri iyi si yose ee,
Ntaho wabona uburuhukiro /2
Bose: Ni muri Yesu, ni muri Yesu,
Ni muri Yesu waruhukira /2

Amahoro yo mu isi yabaye make ku bw’ibyaha by’abantu
Ubwicanyi ubugome biriyongera, ibibazo ni byinshi /2

Nta nshuti n’imwe mu isi yakuruhura, keretse Yesu gusa
Uhereye mu Rwanda no mu isi yose ni Yesu ubwe wenyine /2

IV. Tumwikoreze twese amaganya yacu, kuko yita kuri twe
Muhe umutima wawe awutegeke, wibonere amahoro /2

songs.title: NI NDE MU BAREMWE
paragraphs:
Ni nde mu baremwe bose wabera umuntu icyitegererezo /2
Nta n’umwe keretse Yesu wiyerekanye nk’uworoheje /2
Gukiranuka k’umuntu kurandura kukagira ibizinga /2 None umubona ari mwiza ejo ugasanga yahindutse ukundi /2

Nshuti yanjye mwenedata, sigaho kwiringira umuntu nkawe /2
Uwo kwiringirwa ni umwe, Ni Yesu Umwami ufite ubugingo /2

songs.title: IHEREZO RY’ISI
paragraphs:
I. Iherezo ry’isi rirageze nk’uko byavuzwe n’abahanuzi
Intambara zo hirya no hino byose bigaragaza iherezo /2

Ni ishyano ni ishyano benedata
Ribonywe n’abaturage b’isi,
Iyi isi yacu iri mu mutego
Ubura amaso, reba ijuru.

II. Isi yacu iradandabirana ihumanijwe n’abayituye
Umuvumo ugiye gutsemba isi hunga isi yaciriweho iteka /2

III. Kugambanirana kuzuye isi, ishyari reka sinakubwira
Urukundo rwamaze gukonja, byose bigaragaza iherezo /2

songs.title: MWAMI WANJYE
paragraphs:
Mwami wanjye ndi umukene pe,
Ntacyo nakwishoboza
Umfate ukuboko unyobore;
Maze uzangeze iwawe. /2

I. Iyi si ndimo si ho iwacu, ahubwo ndi umugenzi,
Ndamaranira gakondo nshya ubu yanshyizwe imbere.

II. Yewe Murinzi ngaho tubwire aho igihe kigeze,
Ese uhamanya n’Umwuka Wera, ko tugeze imuhero.

III. Yesu Mukiza Mwami w’abami, akira ibyanjye byose
Umpe kugukurikira hose, maze uzangeze iwawe.

songs.title: NDASHIMIRA UMWAMI YESU
paragraphs:
I. Ndashimira Umwami wacu Yesu, kuko yangiriye imbabazii
Yansanze mu bwigunge nihebye, anduhura imiruho yanjye /2

Yikoreye ububi bwanjye
Arampfira kugira ngo mbeho
Yampaye amahoro menshi
Ampanaguraho ibyaha byanjye /2

II. Ntabwo najyaga niyibutsa ko, nzashyira nkagera imbere ye
Cya gihe azacira urubanza, abantu bose uko bangana /2

III. Sinari nkwiye kuba umwana we, cyangwa kwitwa umugaragu we
None ku bw’urukundo rwe rwinshi, byose yabimpereye ubuntu

songs.title: HWEJESHA AMASO YANJYE
paragraphs:
I. Hwejesha amaso yanjye Mwami ndebe
Ibyo wankoreye ku musaraba /2
Umbwire neza iby’imisumari
Yo mu biganza byera Mana yanjye /2

Ni ku bwawe mwana wanjye ni ku bwawe nshuti yanjye
Ibyo byose byambayeho kugira ngo ukire /2

II. Unyigishe neza iby’i Getsemani
Ya majoro yose waraye Mwami /2
Bya byuya byose wabize Mukiza,
Mbese ni ku bwanjye n’ibyaha byanjye /2

III. Namenye neza iby’umusaraba \
Wabambweho Mwami ko ari ku bwanjye /2
Intimba zanjye zaragushenguye
Umpe ku kwizera Mukiza wanjye /2

songs.title: NYOBORA MWAMI
paragraphs:
I. Nyobora inzira izangeza mu rurembo rw’ijuru Siyoni.
Ni ho abatangiye urugendo bazahererwa yo gakondo.

Isi yacu igiye gushira, kandi izarimburwa n’umuriro,
Nyabuneka muze duhunge, umujinya wenda gutera /2

II. Nyobora inzira kuko meze nk’umugenzi ugenda ku gahinga.
Ndashaka aho nakurirwaho uyu mutwaro uremereye.

III. Nyobora inzira Mwami wanjye kugira ngo nyimenye ntayoba.
Nyakubahwa we ndakwinginze garagaza imbabazi zawe.

IV. Nshobozwa byose na Kristo kuko ari we gusa umpa imbaraga.
Nta kindi nziratana Yesu keretse umusaraba wawe.

songs.title: AMAHORO YO MU IJURU
paragraphs:
Amahoro yo mu ijuru, anyuzuye mu mutima
Reka ndirimbe mpimbaza, uwaremye ijuru n’isi n’inyanja
Yumvise gutaka kwanjye, ambohora ingoyi z’ibyaha
Nuko anyuzuza n’Imana, Yesu ni we wabimpereye ubuntu.

Nezerewe agakiza n’urukundo wangiriye,
Na gakondo yo mu ijuru untegurira ngo tuzabanemo
Sinzakuvirira Mwami, naho nabura ibyo mfite byose
Ndashaka kujyana nawe, aho ujya hose nzagukurikira

Nubwo inzira yazitirwa ikabamo n’imitego
Cya gihe wayiciyemo nanjye ndagukurikira Mukiza.
Sintinyishwa n’urugendo ninanirwa uzajya undamira
Have yewe wa bwoba we namaramaje kujyana na Yesu

Sinzatandukana nawe bona nubwo nababazwa
Unyobore mu kwizera kuko iyi Si iri inyuma y’ibicu
Ntacyatuma ntinya urupfu kuko ari rwo rembo ryo kwinjira
Muri cya gihugu cyiza waringanirije abakwiringira

Mbega urukundo rwawe Mwana w’Intama
Warunyeretse ubwo wanyitangiraga
Ibibi nakoze byari kunyicisha
Wowe wabyishyizeho utacumuye /2

Pilato yatanze umwami Yesu

Kandi nta cyaha yari yakoze

songs.title: KERA IYI SI YACU
paragraphs:
Kera iyi si yacu yari nziza cyane,
Icyaha kije gikingura umuryango
urupfu n’imibabaro biti ‘‘turaje.’’

Gore: Birakwiye ngo tunezerwe
Bose: Mu gihe cy’amahoro
N’igihe cy’umwijima mwinshi
Dutumbira mu ijuru /2

Twari beza twese icyaha kitaraza, twari tugoswe n’ubwiza
Bw’Uwiteka umucyo utumurikira; nimwumve nshuti

Paradizo nziza yandujwe n’abantu, kuremwa kwayo bwari
Ubuturo bwiza kuri twe abantu baremwe mu ishusho yayo

Yesu Umwami wacu ni paradizo nshya, abamwizera
Bakizwa imibabaro, bamurikirwa n’umucyo iteka ryose

songs.title: MU ISI HARIMO IBIRUSHYA
paragraphs:
Mu isi harimo ibirushya bitubuza amahoro
Ariko twihangane nk’uko Yesu yihanganye /2

Mwami Yesu, Mwami Yesu, unyigishe kwihangana
Mwami Yesu, Mwami Yesu uzaza ryari kutujyana ?/2

Mu isi harimo intambara zitubuza kujya iwacu
Ariko tuzanesha nk’uko Yesu yanesheje /2

songs.title: TURI HAFI YO KWAMBUKA
paragraphs:
I. Gabo: Yorodani iriya, Yorodani iriya /2
Gore: Turi hafi yo kwambuka yorodani iriya
Tukagera mu gihugu cyateguriwe abera /2

Gore: Yorodani iyi ihorera nzayambuka mu kwizera
Bose: Maze nimfata hakurya nzahimbaza Umwami Yesu /2

II. Nubwo umwijima ari mwinshi mu nzira aho tunyura
Nushinga aho Yesu avanye ntuzayoba inzira /2

III. Yesu ni we mucyo wacu azatumurikira,
Ngaho niwubure amaso urabona umucyo /2

Gore: Yorodani iyi ihorera nzayambuka mu kwizera
Bose: Maze nimfata hakurya nzahimbaza Umwami Yesu /2
Gabo: Yorodani iriya, Yorodani iriya /2

songs.title: MFITE INSHUTI NZIZA
paragraphs:
Mfite inshuti inkunda cyane ee, ni Yesu umwana w ‘Imana
Yarankunze ntabikwiye ee, nzajya mbimushima iteka /2

Ntashobora kumpemukira aa
Yarankunze kugeza gupfa /2

Uwifuza kuba inshuti ye ee, uwo ari we wese naze
Uwo Mwami ntajya aheza aa, umusange we gutinda /2

Yikoreye ibyaha byanjye ee, abibambanwa ku giti
Nta teka nzacirwaho ukundi ii, kuko Yesu yanesheje /2

songs.title: UMUGAMBI WA SATANI
paragraphs:
Umugambi w’umwanzi Satani,
Muri iyi minsi y’imperuka
Ni uwo gushaka abo yisasira
Kuko iherezo rye riri hafi
Akurikiranye abizeye Yesu, kuko ari we wamunesheje

Gore: Umva yewe mukristo
Bose: Umva yewe mukristo
Gore: Umva yewe usenga
Bose: Umva yewe usenga
Gore: Umva yewe ubwiriza
Bose: Umva yewe ubwiriza
Gore: Umva mudiyakoni
Bose: Umva mudiyakoni
Gore: Umva yewe uririmba
Bose: Umva yewe uririmba
Satani yarahagurutse,
Afite umujinya nk’uw’intare
Saba Imana imbaraga z’Umwuka,
Gumana na Yesu umugaba /2

Hari indi migambi ya Satani,
Tega amatwi nkurondorere
Urwango n’amagambo y’amanjwe,
Gushaka indamu no kwibona,
Kugaragaza ishusho yo kwera,
Kwirema ibice, kwikakaza.

Dore umubisha wacu Satani,
Arashaka uwo aconshomera
Nyamara ntacyo azishoborera,
Ku bakristo bari muri Kristo
Twambare intwaro zose z’Imana, dusenye ibihome by’umwanzi

songs.title: IMINSI DUFITE MU ISI
paragraphs:
Iminsi dufite mu isi, ni iminsi turwana iteka
N’imyuka yo mu kirere y’ubugome bwa Satani /2

Iyaba Uwiteka atari we waturinze iteka
Tuba twaramizwe iteka
Mu bigoyi bya Satani /2

Ku bw’intambara turwana bakunzi b’Umwami Yesu
Ni ngombwa ngo tube dushoreye imizi muri Yesu /2

Iyo tutareba Yesu, iyo tudatumbira Yesu
Tuba twararabye iteka, tutakiri mu isi y’abazima /2

songs.title: ABISIRAHELI
paragraphs:
Abisiraheli bagiye i Kanani,
Bageze ku nyanja babura inzira,
Imbere ni inyanja inyuma ni abanzi
Hirya hino na ho hari imisozi

Gore: Inyanja itukura ikuri imbere
Bose: Uzayambuka kubwo kwizera /2

Nubura inzira wijarajara, tegereza Yesu
We muyobozi. Ni we rutare rutanyeganyega,
Muhungireho aragukiza

Ngwino umwizere umwanya ukiriho,
Reka gutinda udakererwa.
Ni igihe gitoya agakinga urugi
Ngwino banguka atarakinga

songs.title: NKUNDA KURIRIMBA
paragraphs:
Nkunda kuririmba mfite umunezero
Kuko hari impamvu ibintera
Umutima wanjye nawuhaye Yesu
Kuko nta ngabire yaruta iyo

Ni we utanga amahoro tukagubwa neza
Aho azanyobora hose sinzamunanira /2

Nkunda kuririmba mfite umunezero
Kuko hari impamvu ibintera
Mfite isezerano rindema umutima
Iteka ryose ampora iruhande

Nkunda kuririmba mfite umunezero
Kuko hari impamvu ibintera
Nziko hari amazu yaduteguriye
Kuko bidatinze nzagerayo

Nkunda kuririmba mfite umunezero
Kuko hari impamvu ibintera
Mporana amahoro nyahawe na Yesu
Ni yo atuma mpora muririmba

songs.title: HARIHO INDI SI NZIZA CYANE
paragraphs:
I. Gore: Aheza.......mu ijuru ....tuzahu-rirayo bagenzi /2
Bose: Hariho indi si nziza cyane twasezeranijwe n’Imana;
Tuyitegereje twizeye kuko Data ayidufitiye
Gore: Nzamumenya nzamumenya
Nzaba mpagaze imbere ye nyuzwe,
Nzamumenya nzamumenya
Mbonye inkovu zo mu biganza bye
II. Bose: Tuzaririmbira mu ijuru indirimbo z’abakijijwe
Ntituzongera kubabara tuzashira agahinda kose

III. Gore: Nzanezerwa nimbona ubwiza bwo mu maso he,
Kandi sinzasiba kumushimira urukundo n’imbabazi
N’ubuntu byatumye nanjye ambonera ikibanza mu ijuru

IV. Gabo: Data tuzamusingiriza ubwo buntu yatugiriye
N’urukundo rwe n’imbabazi n’imigisha ajya atwungukira /2
Bose: Aheza mu ijuru tuzahurirayo bagenzi /4 Tuzahurirayo bagenzi /3

songs.title: YESU UBWO YAZAGA MU ISI
paragraphs:
Gore:Yesu ubwo yazaga mu isi yazanye ubutumwa bwiza,
Akiza abantu bose kuko ari Umwami w’amahoro.

Gabo: Yaruhuraga abarushye, aha intege abananiwe
Yahazaga abashonje kuko ari Umwami w’amahoro.

Gore: Yababariraga ibyaha, agahoza n’abarira
Akazura abapfuye kuko ari Umwami w’amahoro.
Gabo: Ububasha yari afite, yabuhaye intumwa ze
Zikora ibitangaza kuko ari Umwami w’amahoro

Gore: Hariho umuntu uremaye, wazaga ku rusengero
Ku irembo ryitwaga ryiza; agasaba ngo bamuhe.
Gabo: Intumwa zimunyuzeho, zimukiza ubwo bumuga
Abohorwa ingoyi yamaranye imyaka mirongo ine.

Wa kirema we haguruka aho, wiguma ku irembo ryitwa ryiza
Icyo dufite turakiguha, mu izina rya Yesu ba muzima /2

Gabo: Bagenzi banjye mumfungurire namwe Imana izabaha umugisha
Gabo: Dore ifeza n’izahabu ntabyo, icyo dufite turakiguha

paragraphs:
Ku munsi w’Umwami wacu nari i Patimosi
Inyuma yanjye numva ijwi rimpamagara
Maze nkebutse mbona ni Umwana w’ Intama
Ni ko intumwa yavuze /2

Mubonye ntyo mwikubita imbere nk’upfuye
Anshyiraho ukuboko kwe arambwira ati:
‘‘Witinya ndi uwa mbere ndi n’uw’imperuka
Mporaho iteka ryose’’ /2

Andikira malayika w’i Lawodekiya
Nzi imirimo yawe ko udakonje ntubire
Ubwo udakonje ntubire uri akazuyazi
None ngiye kukuruka /2

Abo nkunda ndabacyaha nkanabahana
Nuko rero ngaho gira umwete wihane
Umuntu ufite ugutwi niyumve ibyo Umwuka
Abwira amatorero /2

songs.title: ITANGIRIRO N’IHEREZO
paragraphs:
I. Itangiriro n’iherezo ni Yesu umwana w’Imana
Ni we wapfuye arazuka ubu ni muzima /2

Gabo: Ni we nzira
Bose: Igana mu bugingo buhoraho
Bose: Ni we kuri
Bose: Iyi si yacu yose ikeneye /2
Bose: Itangiriro n’iherezo ni Yesu umwana w’Imana Ni we wapfuye arazuka ubu ni muzima /2

Yaraye mu mva mu ntambara, arwana na wa mugome
Kuwa gatatu arazuka anesheje urupfu /2

Ni we Alufa na Omega, kuko ntawamubanjirije
Kandi ntawe uzamuheruka kugeza iteka. /2

songs.title: NIMUMVE IMBERE
paragraphs:
Matayo ibice 7: 22
Benshi bazambaza kuri uwo munsi bati:
‘‘Mwami Mwami, ntitwahanuraga mu izina ryawe ?
Ntitwirukanaga abadayimoni mu izina ryawe’’ ?
Nibwo nzaberurira nti:

“Nimumve imbere simbazi,
Nimugende mu muriro
Mwahisemo kurimbuka”/2

I. Gabo: Nyamara Mwami twariraga imbere yawe,
Nyamara Mwami twanyweraga imbere yawe

II. Gabo: Nyamara Mwami twahanuraga mu izina ryawe
Nyamara Mwami twakoraga n’ibitangaza
III. Gabo: Abantu benshi bazirata ibyo bakoraga
Nyamara igihe cy’imirimo kizaba cyashize /2
Bose: Hasigaye icyo guhembwa,
Benshi bazanga ibihembo
Abibeshyaga ubugingo /2

songs.title: TUZAGIRA AMAHORO
paragraphs:
Tuzagira amahoro yomboka nk’uruzi
Imbori z’urupfu zizamirwa bunguri
Imibabaro n’ishavu byo muri iyi si
Bizibagirana /2

Gabo: Nimuze twisunge wa mugaba w’ingabo Kuko umujinya we wibasiye abo mu isi
Twoge mu maraso ye maze twiboneze,
Bose: Tutazarimbuka /2

Icyo gihe impumyi zose zizahumuka
Ibirema bizasimbuka nk’imparage
Indimi z’ibiragi zizagobotoka,
Mbega umunezero /2

Kandi hazabaho inzira nyabagendwa
Izaba ari iyo kwera no gukiranuka
Abanduye imitima ntibazayicamo,
Ni iy’abakijijwe /2

Kuri wa munsi azaza mu ijwi ry’ikondera
Amahanga yose azamuborogera
Ndetse n’abamucumise bazamureba,
Bamarwe n’isoni /2

history.rw:
Iryo tsinda ryari rigizwe n’umugore we, abakobwa babo babiri n’umuvugabutumwa Mbuzukongira Gaspard. Umurimo wabo wakuriye ku kwemera ko Ubutumwa Bwiza bushobora kugera ku bantu bunyuze mu ndirimbo.

Mu 1978, abaririmbyi b’i Nyakabanda n’i Gikondo bakomereje uwo murimo i Nyarugenge. Babanje kwitwa Kigali Choir, nyuma baza kwitwa Hoziana Choir—izina ryamenyekanye mu bisekuru by’abaramya kugeza uyu munsi.
history.en:
The group included his wife, their two daughters and evangelist Mbuzukongira Gaspard. Their ministry grew from a simple conviction: the gospel could be carried through song.

In 1978, singers from Nyakabanda and Gikondo continued the ministry at Nyarugenge. First known as Kigali Choir, the group soon became Hoziana Choir—the name generations of worshippers know today.
history.fr:
Le groupe comprenait son épouse, leurs deux filles et l’évangéliste Mbuzukongira Gaspard. Leur ministère a grandi autour d’une conviction simple : l’Évangile pouvait être porté par le chant.

En 1978, des choristes de Nyakabanda et Gikondo ont poursuivi le ministère à Nyarugenge. D’abord appelé Kigali Choir, le groupe est rapidement devenu Hoziana Choir—le nom que connaissent aujourd’hui plusieurs générations d’adorateurs.
